name: Sawhorn Nemesis
oracle_text:
As this creature enters, choose a player.
If a source would deal damage to the chosen player or a permanent they control, it deals double that damage instead.
blocked_sentences: As this creature enters, choose a player
If a source would deal damage to the chosen player or a permanent they control, it deals double that damage instead

needs.what: an 'as this enters, choose a player' choice remembered on the permanent (the player twin of chosen_type_of/chosen_color_of), readable by statics as a player spec -- e.g. affects_player: {"chosen_player_of": "self"} and an affects filter controller: {"chosen_player_of": "self"} -- so a replace_damage static with damage_multiplier 2 and damage_source controller any can be keyed to the chosen player and the permanents they control
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_player only writes ctx.bindings for the resolving ability, which a static never sees; persistent choices exist only for creature types (chosen_type_of), colors (chosen_color_of) and card types (chosen_card_type_of). replace_damage's affects_player takes you/opponent/any, so 'opponent' would double damage to every opponent (and can never pick yourself), which is a different card at a pod
